t1.text: Onboarding — from install to a filled map in under a minute

t2.text: Core features — map, memories, trips, resurfacing

s1.text:
FEATURE SET

MVP (prototype scope)
• Photo upload + auto-pin from EXIF location/date
• Map home: pins & clusters, tap → memory
• Memory card: photos, note, date, place, mood
• Trips: auto-grouped by date + distance

Next
• Voice notes, tagged travel companions
• 'On this day' resurfacing
• Travel stats (countries, km, cities)
• Shareable trip map / postcard

Later
• Shared maps with friends & family
• Printed map poster / photo book
• Wishlist pins (places to go)

s2.text:
ONBOARDING PRINCIPLES

1. Value before ask — show the map promise before requesting photo access.
2. Explain why — location is read from photos, never tracked live.
3. Zero empty state — auto-import fills the map on first open.
4. One coach mark, not a tour — teach 'tap a pin'.

Key metric: % of new users who open a memory in session 1.
